messages:
adele: Starting a measured refactor: 'capability harmonize' to reduce cross-service leaks between session routing and KV cache. Iterative tiles, not a big rip. Sync tomorrow?

mike: +1. Which pieces are first?

adelle: session-lease, tenant-metadata enrichment, and local kv-get/put. model serving stays global.

zahra: Compatibility: thin facade with header X-Capability: v1 to opt tenants in. fallback to legacy path if tile errors.

tyler: Batching concern 9 keep a batching shim in facade initially. later move batching into tiles for isolation.

infra-bot: create staging slot and tag deploys with "capability-harmonize".

adelle: Acceptance: <=5% p95 delta on hotpath, per-tenant rollback <10m, no telemetry schema changes.

mike: I'll prototype placement API and microbench. zahra: you own tests (semantic diff + migration chaos). tyler: ops runbook and dashboards.

azhara: will add per-tenant metrics: tile.hit_rate, tile.batch.size, tile.queue_p99.

adelle: Actions: RFC by Fri, prototype next sprint, staging canary after. Posting RFC link when ready. Thanks all.
